title: The core set
note: Generated by content/core-set/build.ts from the generator files beside it. Don't edit by hand: change scale.ts or the content files and run npm run content. Every number is a first value, placeholder until the balance pass.

design.note: The core set's shape: parties of 3 in formations of 3 slots, classes of 3 abilities all brought, no perks. The tech keeps 5 slots and perk picks for later.

stats.name: MP regen
stats.note: MP restored every 4 ticks, through the status it brings.

stats.name: Armor
stats.note: A physical hit deals hit² ÷ (hit + 0.25 × Armor): nearly linear against big hits, never a blank.

stats.name: Aggro
stats.note: Centred on 100 (a word n is 70 + 10n, a gear or formation step 10), never below 1. Foes pick by draw, which comes from Aggro through ruleset.draw: an ordinary unit draws 100, none more than 300 or less than 33.

stats.name: Magic resist
stats.note: Step 5j: cuts each magical hit or pulse by this share; 100 is immune. Foes carry it by rank, and Ward gives it.

stats.name: Attack speed
stats.note: Hidden behind Haste, Slow and Chill.

stats.name: Cooldown reduction
stats.note: Hidden behind Haste, Slow and Chill.

stats.name: Cast time reduction
stats.note: Hidden behind Haste, Slow and Chill.

stats.name: Evasion
stats.note: The cap is a placeholder, meant to sit far out of reach.

stats.name: Power
stats.note: Damage dealt by hits and reactions, +%. Only a dungeon's foes modifier sets it: how a campaign trial makes its foes hit harder.

classes.name: Knight
classes.text: Protector. Starts every fight behind its own Shield, Guards whoever is lowest, calls every foe onto itself while an ally regains its mana, and bashes a foe with the weight of its own body.

passive.name: Vanguard
passive.text: It starts every fight behind a Shield that scales from its max HP.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.text: Healer. Mends whoever is lowest with quick, small heals, lifts a curse and wraps the ally in Regen, raises the fallen, and prays twice as fast when its own life is in danger.

passive.name: Last rites
passive.text: Below 30% of its max HP, its cooldowns are halved.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.text: Wears down tough targets. Looses barbed, cold and rending arrows at whatever stands in front, while its plain arrows fly past any guard and open the wounds.

classes.name: Bramble knight
classes.text: Thorns tank. Draws every foe onto its thorns, where each attacker is left bleeding for the party's blows, regrows whoever is lowest, and lashes out with the thorns themselves.

passive.name: Briar
passive.text: Each time its Thorns damage a foe, that foe gets a few Bleed; stacks scale from Armor.

classes.name: Hoplite
classes.text: Bodyguard who opens foes up. Plants its great shield beside the most vulnerable ally to catch the killing blow, locks shields with it, and leaves foes sundered with slow, crushing blows.

passive.name: Phalanx
passive.text: Its basic attacks come half as often and deal double damage.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.text: Shelter against magic. Shelters the party from spells and curses, and brings down slow, heavy, burning judgement, half again as hard on any foe that holds a buff.

passive.name: Judgement
passive.text: Its hits deal half again as much damage to foes with a buff.

classes.name: Valkyrie
classes.text: Storm spear who heals and revives. A storm-borne spear that reaches past any guard and Shocks what it hits, mends the wounded, and snatches the fallen back ready to fight.

passive.name: Einherjar
passive.text: Allies it revives come back with all their actions ready, instead of on cooldown.

classes.name: Bard
classes.text: Party tempo. A caster at the back whose every note mends an ally a little and gives another mana, with a ballad that steadies the whole party, an allegro that quickens it, and thunder that shocks every foe.

passive.name: Refrain
passive.text: Each of its basic attacks that lands heals a random ally and gives a random ally MP, each a share of the damage dealt.

classes.name: Hexer
classes.text: Curser. The debuff bot: burns and shocks every foe a little so the party's statuses pile up, weakens and sunders the most dangerous one, chills whatever it strikes, and silences a foe mid-cast.

passive.name: Cold hex
passive.text: Its basic attacks add a few Chill, whatever weapon it carries; stacks scale from Magic.

classes.name: Monk
classes.text: Sunders with a blur of blows. Every blow leaves the foe a little more open, Flow keeps it fast, burning fists pile onto the hottest foe, and a pressure point drops the most dangerous one for a moment.

passive.name: Iron palm
passive.text: Its basic attacks, and the second strike of its Double strike, add a few Sunder; stacks scale from Attack.

classes.name: Assassin
classes.text: Burst killer. Slips out of sight, picks off the weakest foe past any guard, leaves every crit a bleeding wound, and silences the back line.

passive.name: Lacerate
passive.text: Each of its crits adds several Bleed to the foe; stacks scale from Attack.

classes.name: Vampire
classes.text: Drains to outlast. Feeds on everything it hits: the harder it hits, the more it heals, its prey is left weakened, and it bleeds its own life into an ally's wounds and mana.

passive.name: Bloodlust
passive.text: While it's below half of its max HP, its Lifesteal is doubled.

classes.name: Pyromancer
classes.text: Ramping Burn. Every strike adds Burn, bolts pile more onto the hottest foe, and a pyre lands on it.

passive.name: Kindling
passive.text: Its basic attacks add a few Burn, whatever weapon it carries; stacks scale from Magic.

classes.name: Frostweaver
classes.text: Freezes and shatters. Buries foes in Chill until it shatters into damage and a Stun, leaves the shattered foe sundered for the party, and spends the time it buys keeping an ally's mana flowing.

passive.name: Shatterpoint
passive.text: When a foe's Chill shatters, that foe takes several Sunder; stacks scale from Magic.

classes.name: Stormcaller
classes.text: Shocks every foe. Rains quick strikes across every foe so the fast and the many hurt themselves by acting, and charges itself up to strike faster.

passive.name: Arc
passive.text: Each of its basic attacks also hits a second, random foe, and adds a few Shock to both; stacks scale from Magic.

classes.name: Geomancer
classes.text: Hits hardest behind stone. Wraps itself and an ally in stone; while its own Shield holds, its rocks crit far more often and far harder, and a tremor drops a foe now and then.

passive.name: Bedrock
passive.text: While its Shield pool is above zero, its crit chance is doubled.

gear.text: The wearer's basic attacks deal more the lower its HP: half again as much below 70%, double below 50%, two and a half times below 30%, and triple below 10%. Below 30% HP, each basic attack also heals the wearer for the damage it dealt.

gear.name: Whipcrack wand
gear.text: Double strike medium, +1 Magic.

gear.name: Birch wand
gear.text: +1 Magic, +1 MP.

gear.name: Jolt wand
gear.text: +1 Magic. The wearer's basic attacks add one Shock.

gear.name: Glint wand
gear.text: +1 Crit chance. When one of the wearer's hits crits, the wearer regains 6% of its max MP.

gear.name: Spark wand
gear.text: The wearer's basic attacks add a few Burn.

gear.name: Chain wand
gear.text: The wearer's basic attacks also strike two other foes, each for half.

gear.name: Flicker wand
gear.text: Double strike high. The wearer's extra strikes add a few Shock.

gear.name: Wildmagic wand
gear.text: Each of the wearer's basic attacks adds a few stacks of a random one of Burn, Chill, Shock, Bleed and Sunder.

gear.name: Dowsing rod
gear.text: +2 MP regen.

gear.name: Ironbark rod
gear.text: +1 Magic, +1 HP.

gear.name: Sleet rod
gear.text: +1 Magic. The wearer's basic attacks add one Chill.

gear.name: Cistern rod
gear.text: +1 HP. Once a fight, when the wearer has less than a third of its MP (at the fight's start, or after it casts), it gains Clarity.

gear.name: Glacial rod
gear.text: The wearer's basic attacks Slow their target.

gear.name: Lightning rod
gear.text: When one of the wearer's abilities hits several foes at once, each of those hits lands again on its foe for a quarter of the damage.
gear.note: Echoes `area` hits (engine spec section 6.4): Chain lightning's bounces, not its first strike; Thunderstorm and Blizzard throughout.

gear.name: Winter's chain
gear.text: When a foe's Chill shatters, every other foe gains a few Chill.

gear.name: Brimming rod
gear.text: Each ability the wearer casts gives the ally with the least MP a tenth of that ability's cost in MP. While the wearer has more than half its MP, its abilities cost a quarter less.
gear.note: The gift is a tenth of the MP the cast paid (action_resolve's amount, engine spec X29), so 7.5% of the listed cost while the quarter off holds.

gear.name: Ashwood staff
gear.text: +2 Magic, +1 HP.

gear.name: Moonwater staff
gear.text: +2 MP, +1 Magic.

gear.name: Shepherd's staff
gear.text: +1 Magic, +1 HP. At the start of each fight, the ally with the least MP gains Clarity.

gear.name: Canopy staff
gear.text: +1 Magic, +1 HP. At the start of each fight, the wearer and the other ally with the least max HP each gain a Shield from the wearer's Magic.

gear.name: Banked staff
gear.text: +1 Magic. The wearer's abilities add half again as many Burn, Chill and Shock stacks.

gear.name: Rootstaff
gear.text: Thorns medium. The wearer's Thorns heal it for the damage they deal.

gear.name: Cataclysm staff
gear.text: Every third ability the wearer casts is cast twice. The second cast is free.

gear.name: Cinderheart staff
gear.text: The wearer's basic attacks consume their target's Burn and deal at once all the damage it would have dealt.
gear.note: The flare is 350 a stack: Burn's damage a stack × the sum of its decay at 20 stacks, read from scale.ts.

enemies.name: Snake
enemies.text: Its bite leaves a bleeding wound.

enemies.name: Ogre
enemies.text: Big, slow, and swings a tree.
enemies.note: Its basic attack has a long wind-up: an exception to the no-wind-up default.

enemies.name: Ogre Chief
enemies.text: The biggest ogre, with the biggest club.

enemies.name: Lich
enemies.text: A dead wizard with one big spell.

enemies.name: Ghoul
enemies.text: Ghouls dig each other back up.

enemies.name: Reaper
enemies.text: Death, with a scythe and a bell.

enemies.name: Hellhound
enemies.text: A fire dog; its bite burns.

enemies.name: Lava Slime
enemies.text: Cut it in half and you get two.

enemies.name: Wisp
enemies.text: A tiny spark with a temper.

enemies.name: Drone
enemies.text: The queen's drone: it buzzes in front of her.

enemies.name: Storm King
enemies.text: The Storm Queen's mate. Hurt his soldiers and he gets angry.

enemies.name: Soldier
enemies.text: The king's soldier: it stands in front of him.

enemies.name: Snow Wolf
enemies.text: Hunts in packs, in the snow.
enemies.note: A reskin of the Wolf: the same numbers.

enemies.name: Troll
enemies.text: Big, slow, and swings a tree, under the ground.
enemies.note: A reskin of the Ogre: the same numbers.

enemies.name: Mummy
enemies.text: Hides behind a big, old shield.
enemies.note: A reskin of the Shieldman: the same numbers.

enemies.name: Ice Ghost
enemies.text: Magic passes right through it, cold as it is.
enemies.note: A reskin of the Ghost: the same numbers.

nodes.name: The Old Road
nodes.text: Bandits, wolves and snakes on the road out of town, and an ogre chief at the bridge.

nodes.name: The Road at Night
nodes.text: The same road after dark: more wolves, more arrows, and the chief has brought his brother.

nodes.name: Wildfire
nodes.text: The hills are crawling. Burn them out.

nodes.name: The Crypt
nodes.text: Armored bones, bats you can't hit, ghosts magic can't touch, and Death with a bell.

nodes.name: The Ossuary
nodes.text: Bone piled on bone. Break it.

nodes.name: The Ogre Brothers
nodes.text: Two chiefs, two clubs. Two walls to stand in front of them.

nodes.name: The Fire Mine
nodes.text: Everything here burns, and the lord of the furnace casts a fire that ends parties.

nodes.name: Deep Freeze
nodes.text: Put the mine's fires out, one by one.

nodes.name: Iron Wall
nodes.text: Only plate goes through the foundry.

nodes.name: The Ice Pass
nodes.text: Every fight asks what kind of hit you make. The Titan hides behind a shield of ice and armor like a glacier.

nodes.name: Valhalla
nodes.text: Fall, and rise ready.

nodes.name: The Wild Hunt
nodes.text: Everything that runs in packs, running faster. Don't stand still for it.

nodes.name: The Storm Tower
nodes.text: Clouds of sparks, leeches that drink mana, and a queen behind a wall of drones.

nodes.name: Knives Out
nodes.text: The weak ones hide behind the strong. Find them.

nodes.name: The Long Road
nodes.text: Seven fights and one campfire. Pace yourselves.

nodes.name: The Deep Crypt
nodes.text: Beneath the Crypt, something takes every voice. Power that isn't an ability is the key.

nodes.name: Blood Moon
nodes.text: The dead mend each other, and the chapel takes every voice. Drink deep, and keep singing. Pick your third.

nodes.name: Judgement
nodes.text: Spells, curses and cheering imps. Shelter the party, silence the casters, strike what's lifted up. Pick your third.

nodes.name: The Tower Top
nodes.text: The queen again, at the top of the tower, and the king who rages when his soldiers fall. Strike past them.

nodes.name: The Royal Court
nodes.text: The king and the queen, together.

events.name: A Wounded Traveller
events.text: Someone lies hurt by the road, a weapon still in hand. They look like they can fight.

options.label: TAKE THEM IN
options.text: They join you, hurt: a third of their HP.

options.label: A LESSON
options.text: Patched up, they show one of yours a trick before they go: one member learns an ability or makes one better.

options.label: TAKE THEIR PURSE
options.text: +40 gold.

options.label: WALK ON
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.name: A Blood Shrine
events.text: An altar, a bowl, and something glinting under the stone. The shrine wants blood.

options.label: OFFER BLOOD
options.text: Everyone loses 20% of max HP. A rare piece.

options.label: PRAY
options.text: Everyone recovers 15% of max HP.

options.label: LEAVE
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.name: The Gambler
events.text: A grinning stranger with a pair of bone dice. "Double or nothing?"

options.label: BET 40 GOLD
options.text: Half the time, win 100 back.

options.label: WALK AWAY
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.name: An Abandoned Forge
events.text: The coals are still warm. A smith could make something better here.

options.label: TEMPER A PIECE
options.text: A piece of your choice gains a rarity: common to uncommon, uncommon to rare.

options.label: SCRAP FOR GOLD
options.text: +30 gold from the scrap heap.

events.name: The Old Master
events.text: An old fighter sits by a fire. "I could teach one of you something. It will hurt."

options.label: LEARN THE HARD WAY
options.text: One member learns an ability; everyone loses 10% of max HP.

options.label: PAY 50 TO PRACTISE
options.text: One member's ability gets better (+).

options.label: LEAVE HIM BE
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.name: Ambush!
events.text: The road narrows between two rocks. Something is waiting up there.

options.label: FIGHT
options.text: A hard fight, with an elite's spoils.

options.label: RUN FOR IT
options.text: Everyone loses 10% of max HP.

events.name: A Clear Spring
events.text: Cold water bubbles up through the stones. It tastes of mana.

options.label: DRINK
options.text: Everyone recovers 50% of max MP and 10% of max HP.

options.label: BOTTLE IT
options.text: A tonic for later.

events.name: A Strange Chest
events.text: A chest in the middle of the road, unlocked. Too easy?

options.label: OPEN IT
options.text: Two times in three, a legendary piece. Otherwise it bites: a hard fight.

options.label: LEAVE IT
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.name: An Empty Camp
events.text: Someone left in a hurry: the fire is still burning, the bedrolls still laid out.

options.label: MAKE CAMP
options.text: A campfire: rest, focus, raise or train.

options.label: SEARCH THE PACKS
options.text: A potion, a tonic or a phoenix feather, and 20 gold.

events.name: Pilgrims
events.text: A band of pilgrims with a healer among them. "For a donation…"

options.label: DONATE 40
options.text: Everyone recovers 40% of max HP, and one fallen member rises at half HP (with nobody down, the healer gives you a phoenix feather).

options.label: PASS BY
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.name: A Deserter
events.text: A soldier slumps against a milestone, still in uniform. "I'm done with them. Not with fighting."

options.label: TAKE THEM IN
options.text: They join you at half HP, with an uncommon piece suited to them.

options.label: A LESSON
options.text: They teach one of yours their drill and walk on: one member learns an ability or makes one better.

options.label: TURN THEM IN
options.text: +50 gold.

options.label: TAKE THEM IN
options.text: They join you at half HP, with an uncommon piece suited to them.

options.label: A LESSON
options.text: They teach one of yours their drill and walk on: one member learns an ability or makes one better.

options.label: TURN THEM IN
options.text: +50 gold.

variants.text: An officer, by the look of the blade at their hip, bleeding from a wound they won't explain.

options.label: TAKE THEM IN
options.text: They join you at a third of their HP, knowing two abilities, with a rare piece suited to them.

options.label: A LESSON
options.text: They teach one of yours an officer's drill and walk on: one member learns an ability or makes one better.

options.label: TAKE THE BLADE
options.text: A rare piece; they limp off.

events.name: Mercenaries
events.text: A company of sellswords around a crossroads fire. "Coin first."

options.label: HIRE ONE FOR 60
options.text: Pick one of three recruits.

options.label: WALK ON
options.text: Nothing happens.

options.label: HIRE ONE FOR 60
options.text: Pick one of three recruits.

options.label: WALK ON
options.text: Nothing happens.

variants.text: Veterans, scarred and expensive. "We know our trade."

options.label: HIRE ONE FOR 110
options.text: Pick one of two recruits who know all three abilities.

options.label: WALK ON
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.name: A Prisoner Cart
events.text: A cart with a cage on the back, two guards dozing beside it. The prisoner watches you.

options.label: FREE THE PRISONER
options.text: They join you, and the guards wake: a fight.

options.label: LET IT PASS
options.text: Nothing happens.

options.label: FREE THE PRISONER
options.text: They join you, and the guards wake: a fight.

options.label: LET IT PASS
options.text: Nothing happens.

variants.text: A cart with a cage on the back, and an escort of hard-looking guards. The prisoner wears an old company's colours.

options.label: FREE THE PRISONER
options.text: They join you knowing two abilities, and the escort attacks: a hard fight, with an elite's spoils.

options.label: LET IT PASS
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.name: A Rival Company
events.text: Another party shares the road. Their captain eyes your newest recruit. "A trade? One of yours for one of ours, sight unseen."

options.label: TRADE
options.text: Your newest member (never the leader) leaves; their gear stays in your bag. One of theirs joins, knowing all three abilities.

options.label: DECLINE
options.text: Nothing happens.

options.label: TRADE
options.text: Your newest member (never the leader) leaves; their gear stays in your bag. One of theirs joins, knowing all three abilities.

options.label: DECLINE
options.text: Nothing happens.

variants.text: Another party shares the road, short of hands and long on coin. "A trade, and we'll pay for it."

options.label: TRADE FOR 60
options.text: Your newest member (never the leader) leaves; their gear stays in your bag. One of theirs joins, knowing all three abilities, and +60 gold.

options.label: DECLINE
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.name: An Old Banner
events.text: A war banner, half-buried in the mud. Its company's drill is written on the back.

options.label: TAKE THE DRILL
options.text: A rare formation.

options.label: SELL THE BANNER
options.text: +45 gold.

options.label: TAKE THE DRILL
options.text: A rare formation.

options.label: SELL THE BANNER
options.text: +45 gold.

variants.text: A torn pennant on a broken spear, a few lines of drill still legible.

options.label: TAKE THE DRILL
options.text: A common formation and 20 gold from the spear's fittings.

options.label: SELL THE SPEAR
options.text: +30 gold.

variants.text: A great standard, still upright, ringed by the bones of those who held it. The ground around it is cursed.

options.label: DIG IT OUT
options.text: Everyone loses 15% of max HP. A formation of the highest rarity there is.

options.label: LEAVE IT
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.name: A Training Hall
events.text: Practice dummies, a rack of blunted weapons, and a sergeant with a whistle.

options.label: TRAIN FOR 50
options.text: Two members each learn an ability or make one better (+).

options.label: WATCH
options.text: One member learns an ability.

options.label: TRAIN FOR 50
options.text: Two members each learn an ability or make one better (+).

options.label: WATCH
options.text: One member learns an ability.

variants.text: The sergeant drills anyone who walks in, for free, and hard.

options.label: TAKE THE DRILL
options.text: Two members each learn an ability or make one better (+); everyone loses 15% of max HP.

options.label: WALK ON
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.name: The Master Smith
events.text: A smith with a portable forge and a price for everything. "Bring me anything. I'll make it better."

options.label: TEMPER
options.text: A common or uncommon piece of yours gains a rarity.

options.label: REFORGE
options.text: A rare piece of yours is reforged into a legendary of its slot.

options.label: SELL HIM SCRAP
options.text: +40 gold.

options.label: TEMPER
options.text: A common or uncommon piece of yours gains a rarity.

options.label: REFORGE
options.text: A rare piece of yours is reforged into a legendary of its slot.

options.label: SELL HIM SCRAP
options.text: +40 gold.

variants.text: The smith is drunk, cheerful and working for free. "Give it here. I'll make it sing."

options.label: LET HIM TRY
options.text: A piece of yours gains a rarity (a rare one becomes a legendary of its slot). Half the time it cracks and is lost.

options.label: WALK ON
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.name: A Prisoner Convoy
events.text: Three prisoners in chains on a cart, their confiscated gear in a sack beside the guards.

options.label: FREE ONE
options.text: Pick one of three prisoners, each with a piece from the sack. The guards attack: a fight.

options.label: BRIBE THE GUARDS
options.text: Pick one of three prisoners, each with a piece from the sack. No fight.

options.label: RIDE ON
options.text: Nothing happens.

options.label: FREE ONE
options.text: Pick one of three prisoners, each with a piece from the sack. The guards attack: a fight.

options.label: BRIBE THE GUARDS
options.text: Pick one of three prisoners, each with a piece from the sack. No fight.

options.label: RIDE ON
options.text: Nothing happens.

variants.text: A convoy of hardened convicts under heavy guard. One wears an old company's colours.

options.label: FREE ONE
options.text: Pick one of three, each knowing two abilities and carrying a rare piece. The escort attacks: a hard fight, with an elite's spoils.

options.label: RIDE ON
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.name: An Old Soldier
events.text: A grey-haired soldier sharpening a blade by the road. "Still got some fight in me. Or some sense, if you'd rather."

options.label: TAKE HIM IN
options.text: He joins you, knowing two abilities.

options.label: A LESSON
options.text: Two members each learn an ability or make one better; he stays by the road.

options.label: TAKE HIM IN
options.text: He joins you, knowing two abilities.

options.label: A LESSON
options.text: Two members each learn an ability or make one better; he stays by the road.

variants.text: An old soldier with a limp, too slow to march with anyone, too proud to beg.

options.label: TAKE HIM IN
options.text: He joins you at half HP, knowing two abilities, with an uncommon piece suited to him.

options.label: A LESSON
options.text: One member learns an ability or makes one better.

options.label: WALK ON
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.name: Three Sealed Crates
events.text: Three crates, nailed shut and stamped with a merchant's mark. Room on your cart for one.

options.label: OPEN ONE
options.text: A piece of unknown rarity: one crate holds a legendary, one a rare, one a common.

options.label: LEAVE THEM
options.text: Nothing happens.

options.label: OPEN ONE
options.text: A piece of unknown rarity: one crate holds a legendary, one a rare, one a common.

options.label: LEAVE THEM
options.text: Nothing happens.

variants.text: Three crates, nailed shut, and the merchant's boy, who'll pry open a second for a coin.

options.label: OPEN ONE
options.text: A piece of unknown rarity: one crate holds a legendary, one a rare, one a common.

options.label: OPEN TWO
options.text: Two of the three crates, at random.

events.name: The Quartermaster's Wagon
events.text: An army wagon, and a quartermaster happy to sell what the army won't miss.

options.label: BUY THE BUNDLE
options.text: A formation and a tonic.

options.label: TAKE THE SPARE KIT
options.text: A common piece and a potion.

options.label: BUY THE BUNDLE
options.text: A formation and a tonic.

options.label: TAKE THE SPARE KIT
options.text: A common piece and a potion.

variants.text: An army wagon stuck to the axles in mud, its quartermaster red in the face.

options.label: PUSH IT FREE
options.text: Everyone loses 10% of max HP. A formation and a potion, in thanks.

options.label: WALK ON
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.name: A Field Hospital
events.text: Tents, cots, and a surgeon who has seen worse than you.

options.label: PAY THE SURGEON
options.text: Everyone recovers 40% of max HP, and the fallen rise at half HP.

options.label: HIRE THE MEDIC
options.text: One who heals or raises others joins you.

options.label: WALK ON
options.text: Nothing happens.

options.label: PAY THE SURGEON
options.text: Everyone recovers 40% of max HP, and the fallen rise at half HP.

options.label: HIRE THE MEDIC
options.text: One who heals or raises others joins you.

options.label: WALK ON
options.text: Nothing happens.

variants.text: A hospital overrun with wounded. The surgeon looks up: "You. Hands. Now."

options.label: HELP OUT
options.text: Everyone loses 15% of max MP. A potion and a phoenix feather, from the stores.

options.label: WALK ON
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.name: The War Table
events.text: A deserted command tent, the maps still pinned to the table.

options.label: STUDY THE MAPS
options.text: A rare formation; everyone loses 10% of max MP (a long night).

options.label: SELL THE MAPS
options.text: +50 gold.

options.label: STUDY THE MAPS
options.text: A rare formation; everyone loses 10% of max MP (a long night).

options.label: SELL THE MAPS
options.text: +50 gold.

variants.text: A command tent with one tired sentry dozing at the flap.

options.label: SLIP IN
options.text: A formation. The sentry wakes and calls the guard: a fight.

options.label: BACK AWAY
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.name: A Duelling Ground
events.text: A ring of stakes, a champion inside it, and a crowd that wants blood.

options.label: CHALLENGE THE CHAMPION
options.text: A hard fight, with an elite's spoils: a legendary, then a formation.

options.label: WATCH
options.text: One member learns an ability or makes one better from the champion's form.

options.label: CHALLENGE THE CHAMPION
options.text: A hard fight, with an elite's spoils: a legendary, then a formation.

options.label: WATCH
options.text: One member learns an ability or makes one better from the champion's form.

variants.text: An empty ring. The last champion's gear hangs on a stake under a sign: TAKE IT IF YOU CAN LIFT IT.

options.label: LIFT IT
options.text: A legendary piece; everyone loses 20% of max HP.

options.label: WORK THE CROWD
options.text: +30 gold.

events.name: The Abandoned Armoury
events.text: Racks of old weapons behind a door hanging off its hinges. Something breathes further in.

options.label: SEARCH
options.text: Two uncommon pieces.

options.label: SEARCH DEEPER
options.text: Three rare pieces, and whatever breathes wakes: a hard fight, with an elite's spoils.

options.label: SEARCH
options.text: Two uncommon pieces.

options.label: SEARCH DEEPER
options.text: Three rare pieces, and whatever breathes wakes: a hard fight, with an elite's spoils.

variants.text: The armoury's old caretaker is still here, and wants paying for what he's kept oiled all these years.

options.label: BUY THE BEST
options.text: A legendary piece.

options.label: SEARCH THE SCRAPS
options.text: A common piece and 15 gold.

events.name: A Mana Spring
events.text: A pool that glows a faint blue. The water stings.

options.label: BATHE
options.text: Everyone back to full MP; everyone loses 15% of max HP.

options.label: FILL A FLASK
